description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of categories within the FineWeb-Edu Classifier dataset. The chart contains 21 distinct slices, each representing a different subject area. The slices are labeled as follows: Teaching & resources (15 and 17, in two separate slices), Science & technology education (10 and 19, in two separate slices), Education (25 and 38, in two separate slices), History & Society (23), Health & Medicine (22 and 19, in two separate slices), Diseases (11 and 10, in two separate slices), Nutrition (5 and 7, in two separate slices), Animal & Plant (13 and 12, in two separate slices), Historical review (7 and 12, in two separate slices), Materials (3, in three separate slices), Society & culture (10 and 5, in two separate slices), Events & people (6 and 2, in two separate slices), Info tech (5 and 3, in two separate slices), Fin & Law (3), Emerging tech (4), Policy (1), and Healthy education (2). The slices are colored in a variety of shades, including blues, reds, greens, and oranges. Percentage labels are not displayed directly on the slices, but numerical values are provided alongside each label. The chart includes a legend identifying each category and its corresponding color. The slices appear to be arranged in a roughly descending order based on their size, though this is not strictly consistent across the entire chart.
